Volution Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, makes and supplies ventilation products to residential and commercial construction markets primarily in the United Kingdom and Northern Europe. The company has market cap of 430.94 million GBP. The firm operates through two divisions, the Ventilation Group and Torin-Sifan. It has a 29.07 P/E ratio. The companyÂ’s products include unitary extractor fans for use in bathrooms and kitchens; MVHR and MEV systems; rigid, semi-rigid, and flexible ducting products and accessories; mechanical heat recovery units; air handling units and fan coils; commercial ventilation products; underfloor heating, heated towel rails, radiators, and storage and panel heaters; wall, box, and tower fans, as well as portable air conditioners; hand dryers and insect killers; and sensors, controllers, and ducting products.
